definition.description: REV | Acceptance | Create Envelope (wbs:3.2, DEV only per EX-006/EX-007). TAD rev 15: creates a DocuSign draft, binds both signers, sets the referee access code, fills and checks every tab, sets reminders, then sends (FR-041/042/043). See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. The DocuSign account this flow sends envelopes through (C-TECH-047).
Environment variable. The DocuSign template this flow builds each envelope from (C-TECH-047). See notes.md.

When_a_grant_is_created.description: A-DS-3: row CREATED on rev_grant. Grant rows are created only for approvals (TAD 5.7); the default status (1, Awarded) IS the approved state rev_grantstatus.xml's own comment describes. See notes.md.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Holds the failed action name and reason for the alert. Top level, same pattern as every other flow in this solution. See notes.md.

Initialise_check_problem.description: What a pre-send check found missing, in words, never a value. Empty means the check passed.

Initialise_draft_envelope_id.description: The DocuSign draft's id once it exists, so every alert can name the orphaned draft (A-R74). Empty means no draft was created.

Compose_run_link.description: Deep link to THIS run. Built before the scope so the in-scope check alerts can use it too; workflow() inside the child returns the child's own identity.

Build_the_envelope.description: One scope so one failure branch catches everything below it. TAD rev 15 5.8: draft, bind, fill, check, remind, send (ADR-067 C1-C10 option A, ADR-068).

Get_the_application.description: A-DS-3: reads the Application this grant was awarded against, by primary key via ListRecords - NOT the connector's Get-a-row-by-id action, per IMP-0112/IMP-0116's proven pattern for this connector. See notes.md.

Get_the_applicant.description: The applicant's name, email, title, address and phone for the envelope's tabs. Column-secured (REV_TrusteeRestricted): the service identity must be a member, or they read empty. By primary key via ListRecords.

Skip_provider_lookup_if_none_is_set.description: rev_providerid can be empty (WBS 0.4 remainder, RequiredLevel None) - an empty guid in $filter would be a malformed query rather than a clean miss.

Get_the_provider.description: Reads the provider name for the envelope's pre-populated fields (TAD 5.8). By primary key via ListRecords, same reason as the two reads above.

Compose_provider_name.description: Falls back to a placeholder when no provider is set (rev_providerid RequiredLevel None), rather than failing a run the TAD does not require this field for.

Read_acceptance_email_settings.description: ADR-068 item 3: each signer's own email subject and body, from rev_setting rows AcceptanceEmailApplicant and AcceptanceEmailReferee (JSON {subject, body}). House ListRecords read. No personal column.

Filter_applicant_email_setting.description: The applicant's email row. Empty when the row is not seeded; Set_referee_details_problem then stops the run before any draft exists.

Filter_referee_email_setting.description: The referee's email row. Its body states the access-code RULE (last 6 digits of your phone number), never the digits (ADR-068 item 4).

Compose_acceptance_email_texts.description: Subject and body per signer from the settings rows. Tokens: {grantReference}, {applicationReference}, {applicantName}, {refereeName}. Line breaks in the row (\n) are kept.

Select_referee_phone_digits.description: ADR-068 item 4: keeps every DIGIT of rev_refereephone and drops everything else (spaces, +, -, brackets, letters). Padded by one space so substring() is total on either if() semantics.

Compose_referee_phone_digits.description: The referee's phone, digits only. Secure inputs: derived from personal data.

Set_referee_details_problem.description: TAD 5.8 step 1: names the FIRST missing item in words, never its value. Empty means all present. A variable action shows only this text in run history.

inputs.name: checkProblem
inputs.value: @if(empty(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['applicantSubject']), 'the settings row AcceptanceEmailApplicant is missing or has no subject', if(empty(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['applicantBody']), 'the settings row AcceptanceEmailApplicant has no body', if(greater(length(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['applicantSubject']), 100), 'the AcceptanceEmailApplicant subject is longer than 100 characters', if(empty(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['refereeSubject']), 'the settings row AcceptanceEmailReferee is missing or has no subject', if(empty(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['refereeBody']), 'the settings row AcceptanceEmailReferee has no body', if(greater(length(outputs('Compose_acceptance_email_texts')?['refereeSubject']), 100), 'the AcceptanceEmailReferee subject is longer than 100 characters', if(empty(trim(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_applicant')?['body/value'])?['rev_email'], ''))), 'the applicant email is empty', if(empty(trim(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_applicant')?['body/value'])?['rev_firstname'], ''))), 'the applicant first name is empty or not readable by the service identity', if(empty(trim(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_application')?['body/value'])?['rev_refereename'], ''))), 'the referee name is empty', if(empty(trim(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_application')?['body/value'])?['rev_refereeemail'], ''))), 'the referee email is empty', if(less(length(outputs('Compose_referee_phone_digits')), 6), 'the referee phone number has fewer than six digits', '')))))))))))

Check_referee_details_are_present.description: TAD 5.8 step 1 / ADR-068 items 3-4: anything missing -> alert, then stop (Failed). No draft exists yet, nobody is emailed, the grant stays at Awarded.

Alert_referee_details_missing.description: FR-010: the grant reference and WHICH item is missing, never a value. Same alert-then-stop shape as REV | Portal | Round Statistics.

body.text_2: @{concat('No envelope was created: ', variables('checkProblem'), '. Nothing was sent to DocuSign and the grant stays at Awarded.')}

Stop_referee_details_missing.description: Stops the run whether or not the alert succeeded; the run's own error says why.

runError.message: A settings row or a referee detail the envelope needs is missing. Nothing was sent to DocuSign.

Compose_access_code.description: ADR-068 item 4: the last six digits of the normalised referee phone. Total on any length (padded); only reached when there are 6 or more. Secure inputs. A-DS-17.

Compose_connector_tab_types.description: Read tabType to update enum, every spelling (text/Text/textTabs); canon = textTabs-style key. neverSend: signature, full name, sign date (reviewer), email address (DocuSign fills it from the signer), tab groups.

Compose_tab_values.description: Every tab bar signature, full name, sign date (reviewer). Both roles take every placeholder; the role picks the source. '' = no source, clears it. Box sent UNTICKED. A-DS-4, A-DS-5, A-DS-15.

Create_the_draft_envelope.description: ADR-067 C1, E1 from TEST_Docusign v2c: a DRAFT (status Created) from the server template. Emails nobody. A-DS-14: that it carries both template roles as placeholder signers.

Set_draft_envelope_id.description: Every later DocuSign call and every failure alert reads the id from here, so an orphaned draft can be found and deleted (A-R74). DocuSign-generated, not personal.

List_the_envelope_recipients.description: ADR-067 C2: the draft's signers with their DocuSign recipientId and roleName. Ids are read, never assumed (A-DS-14).

Filter_the_applicant_signer.description: The template role the applicant fills. Exactly one is required (checked below).

Filter_the_referee_signer.description: The template role the referee fills. Exactly one is required (checked below).

Find_the_document.description: ADR-067 C5, design req. 7: the template's FIRST document (the acceptance form), not a file name. Later documents (general T&Cs) carry no tabs and are not filled. A-DS-15: its documentId is the envelope's. No personal data.

Set_draft_shape_problem.description: Counts only, never a name. Empty means one signer per role and at least one document.

inputs.name: checkProblem
inputs.value: @if(not(equals(length(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer')), 1)), concat('the draft has ', string(length(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))), ' signer(s) with role Grant Acceptor, expected 1'), if(not(equals(length(body('Filter_the_referee_signer')), 1)), concat('the draft has ', string(length(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))), ' signer(s) with role Grant Referee, expected 1'), if(equals(length(coalesce(body('Find_the_document')?['templateDocuments'], json('[]'))), 0), 'the template has no documents, expected at least 1', '')))

Check_the_draft_matches_the_template.description: A missing or doubled role would leave a signer with no fields (ADR-068 H2). Alert with the draft id, then stop. Nobody is emailed.

Alert_draft_does_not_match_template.description: FR-010 with the draft's envelope id (A-R74), counts only.

body.text_2: @{concat('The DocuSign draft does not match the template: ', variables('checkProblem'), '. Nobody was emailed. Delete draft envelope ', variables('draftEnvelopeId'), ' in DocuSign.')}

Stop_draft_does_not_match_template.description: Stops the run whether or not the alert succeeded.

runError.message: The DocuSign draft's roles or documents are not what the flow expects. Nothing was sent.

Bind_the_applicant.description: ADR-067 C3 (E1, v2c): fills the Grant Acceptor placeholder, routing order 1 (FR-042), own subject/body (ADR-068 item 3). A-DS-14 (fills, not adds); A-DS-16 (language string).

Bind_the_referee.description: ADR-067 C3: Grant Referee. No routingOrder: the template locks it, and sending it made DocuSign reject the whole update (2026-10-04). Signing order comes from the template. No phoneNumber (design req. 3).

Require_referee_access_code.description: ADR-068 item 4 / ADR-067 C4 (E1, v2c): the referee must enter the code before the document opens. A-DS-17: that the account's access-code format accepts six digits.

Read_the_tabs.description: ADR-067 C6: one read of every tab on the document, prefill and recipient. A-DS-15: tabLabel and recipientId on each tab are not yet observed.

Filter_tabs_in_scope.description: Every tab except signature, full name and sign date for both signers (reviewer) and tabGroups, which hold no value.

Select_tab_matches.description: Each tab matched by Data Label, else placeholder within its owner (recipientId or recipientIdGuid), else type. tabType = connector enum, rawType = read form. Unmatched: id ''.

select.id: @coalesce(outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat('label|', string(coalesce(item()?['tabLabel'], '')))]?['id'], outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat(if(equals(item()?['prefill'], true), 'prefill', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'referee', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'applicant', 'other'))), '|', string(coalesce(item()?['value'], '')))]?['id'], outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat(if(equals(item()?['prefill'], true), 'prefill', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'referee', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'applicant', 'other'))), '|type:', coalesce(outputs('Compose_connector_tab_types')?['canon']?[string(coalesce(item()?['tabType'], ''))], string(coalesce(item()?['tabType'], ''))))]?['id'], '')
select.value: @coalesce(outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat('label|', string(coalesce(item()?['tabLabel'], '')))]?['value'], outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat(if(equals(item()?['prefill'], true), 'prefill', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'referee', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'applicant', 'other'))), '|', string(coalesce(item()?['value'], '')))]?['value'], outputs('Compose_tab_values')?[concat(if(equals(item()?['prefill'], true), 'prefill', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_referee_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'referee', if(contains(createArray(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientId'], '-')), string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_applicant_signer'))?['recipientIdGuid'], '-'))), string(coalesce(item()?['recipientId'], ''))), 'applicant', 'other'))), '|type:', coalesce(outputs('Compose_connector_tab_types')?['canon']?[string(coalesce(item()?['tabType'], ''))], string(coalesce(item()?['tabType'], ''))))]?['value'], '')

Filter_tabs_to_fill.description: Tabs with a known source and a known connector type.

Filter_unmapped_tabs.description: Tabs on the template the flow has no mapping or type for. The reviewer requires every tab filled, so any here stops the run.

Select_unmapped_tab_descriptions.description: Owner, tab type and the TEMPLATE's placeholder text of each unmapped tab, for the alert.

Select_tab_array.description: The one {tabType, tabId, value} array (E1 body shape, v2c), connector enum from Compose_connector_tab_types. A-DS-16.

Re_read_the_tabs.description: ADR-067 C8: read every tab again after the fill.

Select_re_read_values.description: tabId|value for every tab as DocuSign now holds it; a checkbox reads 'selected' (A-DS-16), lower-cased.

Select_found_tab_ids.description: Which expected tabs were found on the draft at all.

Filter_missing_tabs.description: Tabs that must exist: 5 prefill, and first/last name, title, postcode, phone for each signer. Every other tab is covered by the no-mapping check.

Filter_unfilled_tabs.description: Tabs whose re-read value differs from the value sent, company tabs included (they now get their own call).

Select_unfilled_tab_ids.description: Tab identifiers only, for the alert.

Set_tab_fill_problem.description: Tab identifiers and template placeholder text only, never values. Empty means every tab is mapped and holds what was sent.

inputs.name: checkProblem
inputs.value: @if(and(empty(body('Filter_missing_tabs')), empty(body('Select_unfilled_tab_ids')), empty(body('Select_unmapped_tab_descriptions'))), '', concat('tabs not found on the draft: [', join(body('Filter_missing_tabs'), ', '), ']; tabs not holding the value sent: [', join(body('Select_unfilled_tab_ids'), ', '), ']; template tabs with no mapping: [', join(body('Select_unmapped_tab_descriptions'), ', '), ']'))

Check_every_tab_was_filled.description: ADR-067 C8: a tab not found or not filled -> alert naming the TAB and the draft id, then stop. Option A cannot fail silently; switch C7 to option B if the first run stops here.

Alert_tabs_not_filled.description: FR-010 with the tab identifiers and the draft's envelope id (A-R74).

body.text_2: @{concat('The DocuSign draft was not filled as expected: ', variables('checkProblem'), '. Nobody was emailed. Delete draft envelope ', variables('draftEnvelopeId'), ' in DocuSign.')}

Stop_tabs_not_filled.description: Stops the run whether or not the alert succeeded.

runError.message: One or more envelope tabs were not found or do not hold the value sent. Nothing was sent.

Read_reminder_days.description: A-DS-11 (IMP-0618 resolution): reads Setting.ReminderDays - [first, second] reminder day, JSON array. Reviewer decision: the seeded table drives cadence, discarding the template's own static 2/5-day config.

Parse_reminder_days.description: A-DS-11: falls back to [3,7] - the TAD's own literal (5.9/FR-043) - if the row is ever absent, same resilience pattern as A-DS-6 (EscalationDays).

Compose_reminder_cadence.description: A-DS-11: AddReminders takes delay+frequency, not two fixed days. Reproduces 'day 3, day 7' as the first two firings only - does not stop repeating after that. See notes.md.

Set_reminder_cadence.description: A-DS-11 (IMP-0618): DocuSign AddReminders on the DRAFT, before the send (ADR-067 C9). A-DS-16: accepted on a draft and kept after the send. Reads only the envelope id.

Send_the_envelope.description: ADR-067 C10 (E1, v2c): draft -> sent. The applicant is emailed now, the referee after the applicant signs. A-DS-14: sends the draft as filled. Reads only the envelope id.

Write_the_envelope_id_and_issue_date.description: ADR-G04, WBS 3.2: writes rev_docusignenvelopeid and rev_acceptanceissuedon and moves rev_status 1 -> 2, only after Send_the_envelope succeeded (ADR-067 consequence 7).

Set_tabs_to_fill_problem.description: Empty unless no tab matched. Then names the tab types read and the unmatched tabs (template placeholders, no personal data), instead of DocuSign's bare 'No tabs specified'.

inputs.name: checkProblem
inputs.value: @if(empty(body('Select_tab_array')), concat('no tab on the draft could be matched to a value; ', string(length(coalesce(body('Read_the_tabs')?['tabs'], json('[]')))), ' tab(s) read; tabs with no mapping: [', join(body('Select_unmapped_tab_descriptions'), ', '), ']'), if(empty(body('Filter_prefill_tabs')), 'no prefill tab could be matched', if(empty(body('Filter_applicant_tabs')), 'no Grant Acceptor tab could be matched', if(empty(body('Filter_referee_tabs')), 'no Grant Referee tab could be matched', ''))))

Check_there_are_tabs_to_fill.description: Nothing to fill means the template's tabs were not recognised. Alert with the draft id and what was read, then stop. Nobody is emailed.

Alert_no_tabs_to_fill.description: FR-010 with the draft's envelope id (A-R74), tab types and placeholders only.

body.text_2: @{concat('No DocuSign tab could be filled: ', variables('checkProblem'), '. Nobody was emailed. Delete draft envelope ', variables('draftEnvelopeId'), ' in DocuSign.')}

Stop_no_tabs_to_fill.description: Stops the run whether or not the alert succeeded.

runError.message: No tab on the DocuSign draft could be matched to a value. Nothing was sent.

Filter_prefill_tabs.description: Tabs to fill owned by prefill. The prefill action updates prefill tabs only; each signer's tabs go through Update recipient tab values.

Filter_applicant_tabs.description: Tabs to fill owned by applicant. The prefill action updates prefill tabs only; each signer's tabs go through Update recipient tab values.

Filter_referee_tabs.description: Tabs to fill owned by referee. The prefill action updates prefill tabs only; each signer's tabs go through Update recipient tab values.

Fill_the_prefill_tabs.description: Prefill tabs, tabType as read (textTabs), the reviewer's v2c shape. On failure the next action retries with the connector enum (Text). Which form works is not yet measured.

Fill_the_prefill_tabs_with_enum.description: Runs only if the read-form call failed: same tabs, tabType as the connector enum (Text).

Fill_the_applicant_tabs.description: Grant Acceptor's tabs, tabType as the connector enum (Text, as the designer writes it, E1). On failure the next action retries with the read form.

Fill_the_applicant_tabs_as_read.description: Runs only if the enum call failed: same tabs, tabType as read (textTabs).

Fill_the_referee_tabs.description: Grant Referee's tabs, tabType as the connector enum (Text, E1). On failure the next action retries with the read form.

Fill_the_referee_tabs_as_read.description: Runs only if the enum call failed: same tabs, tabType as read (textTabs).

Read_the_signers_after_binding.description: Re-reads both signers after binding. DocuSign answers 200 even when it rejects a recipient update, so the check below compares what it holds with what was sent.

Filter_the_bound_applicant.description: The applicant signer as DocuSign holds it after binding.

Filter_the_bound_referee.description: The referee signer as DocuSign holds it after binding.

Set_signer_binding_problem.description: Empty when DocuSign holds the email sent for each signer. Names the role only, never the address.

inputs.name: checkProblem
inputs.value: @if(not(equals(toLower(trim(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_bound_applicant'))?['email'], '')))), toLower(trim(string(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_applicant')?['body/value'])?['rev_email'], '')))))), 'the Grant Acceptor signer does not hold the applicant email that was sent', if(not(equals(toLower(trim(string(coalesce(first(body('Filter_the_bound_referee'))?['email'], '')))), toLower(trim(string(coalesce(first(outputs('Get_the_application')?['body/value'])?['rev_refereeemail'], '')))))), 'the Grant Referee signer does not hold the referee email that was sent', ''))

Check_both_signers_are_bound.description: A signer DocuSign did not update would get no email or the wrong one. Alert with the draft id, then stop. Nobody is emailed.

Alert_signer_not_bound.description: FR-010 with the draft's envelope id (A-R74), role only.

body.text_2: @{concat('A DocuSign signer was not updated: ', variables('checkProblem'), '. Nobody was emailed. Delete draft envelope ', variables('draftEnvelopeId'), ' in DocuSign.')}

Stop_signer_not_bound.description: Stops the run whether or not the alert succeeded.

runError.message: DocuSign did not take a signer's name and email. Nothing was sent.

Filter_referee_company_tabs.description: The referee's company tabs. Sent in the same call as text tabs (type Company) DocuSign dropped them (2026-10-04), so they get their own call below.

Fill_the_referee_company_tabs_if_any.description: Skips the call when the template has no referee company tab: DocuSign rejects an empty tab list.

Select_referee_company_tab_array.description: {tabType, tabId, value} for the company tabs, tabType as read.

Fill_the_referee_company_tabs.description: Company tabs only, tabType as the read returns it (companyTabs). The read-back check below shows whether DocuSign took it.

Find_the_failed_action.description: Same pattern as REV | Scoring | Calculate & Flag: the child of the failed scope whose own status is Failed, not the scope's generic wrapper message.

Describe_the_failure.description: When the failed child is a container, descend one level to the action that actually failed (IMP-0349, check 7). One case per container in Build_the_envelope; default = already a leaf.

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_provider.description: Only evaluated when Skip_provider_lookup_if_none_is_set is the failure, so result() on it is safe.

Set_failure_detail_from_the_provider_loo.description: The leaf action inside the nested container - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_provider_lookup'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_provider_lookup'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_provider_lookup'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_referee_.description: Only evaluated when Check_referee_details_are_present is the failed child, so result() on it is safe (A-FLOW-13).

Set_failure_detail_from_the_referee_chec.description: The leaf action inside the nested container - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_referee_check'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_referee_check'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_referee_check'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_draft_ch.description: Only evaluated when Check_the_draft_matches_the_template is the failed child, so result() on it is safe (A-FLOW-13).

Set_failure_detail_from_the_draft_check.description: The leaf action inside the nested container - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_draft_check'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_draft_check'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_draft_check'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tab_chec.description: Only evaluated when Check_every_tab_was_filled is the failed child, so result() on it is safe (A-FLOW-13).

Set_failure_detail_from_the_tab_check.description: The leaf action inside the nested container - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tab_check'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tab_check'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tab_check'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tabs_to_.description: Only evaluated when Check_there_are_tabs_to_fill is the failed child, so result() on it is safe (A-FLOW-13).

Set_failure_detail_from_the_tabs_to_fill.description: The leaf action inside the nested container - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tabs_to_fill_check'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tabs_to_fill_check'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_tabs_to_fill_check'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Find_the_failed_step_inside_the_signer_b.description: Only evaluated when Check_both_signers_are_bound is the failed child, so result() on it is safe (A-FLOW-13).
